en.headline: Man arrested after laundry pods dumped in Kam Ying Court turtle pond
en.dek: Police detained a 42-year-old man on suspicion of cruelty to animals after chemical laundry pods caused one fish to die and injured more than 30 turtles at the Ma On Shan estate.
body: Sha Tin police arrested a 42-year-old man on Friday on suspicion of cruelty to animals after laundry pods were thrown into a turtle pond at Kam Ying Court Phase 2 in Ma On Shan.

The incident was discovered on Wednesday when security staff found large amounts of foam in the pond. Animal rescue group The Turtle’s Inn said the strong alkaline chemicals killed one fish and left more than 30 turtles, including several species, with chemical burns; some had eyes turned white and required treatment.

Estate management emptied and cleaned the pond and returned the turtles after treatment. Police said the man remains in custody pending further inquiries. Residents said the pond has housed turtles for more than 20 years without similar incidents.

zh.headline: 錦英苑龜池遭投洗衣球 警拘42歲男涉殘酷對待動物
zh.dek: 馬鞍山錦英苑二期水池周三發現大量泡沫，一魚死亡、逾30隻龜灼傷，沙田警區刑事調查隊周五以涉嫌殘酷對待動物拘捕一名42歲男子。
body: 沙田警區刑事調查隊第五隊周五以涉嫌殘酷對待動物罪名，拘捕一名42歲男子，他現正被扣留調查。
事發於周三，馬鞍山錦英苑二期保安巡邏時發現屋苑內一個養有龜隻的水池水質異常並有大量泡沫。動物救援組織「龜途」表示，強烈鹼性化學物導致一條魚當場死亡，逾30隻龜包括斑龜、巴西龜等皮膚甚至眼睛被灼傷變白，需接受治療。
管理處已將龜隻救出、徹底清洗水池並重新注水。居民指龜池已有逾20年歷史，過往未發生類似惡意傷害事件。警方經翻看閉路電視後採取行動。
